content: To determine the dimensions of the class subspaces and query subspace of MSM and TF-MSM, and the dimension of the approximation performed by LSA, we performed a 10-fold cross validation, wherein each fold, the data were randomly divided into train (60%), validation (20%) and test set (20%).
